```{python}
#| label: fig-dibl
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Threshold-voltage shift $\\Delta V_\\mathrm{th}$ due to DIBL as a function of gate length, calculated with the model of @eq-mosfet-dibl for a characteristic length $l_\\mathrm{d} = 15\\,$nm. For short gate lengths and high drain voltages, the threshold voltage drops rapidly (compare, e.g., the measured data for a 65 nm technology in [@Goto_2003])."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ld = 15e-9
L = np.linspace(20e-9, 200e-9, 300)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
for vds, style in [(0.05, 'b--'), (1.2, 'b-')]:
    dvth = -(vds + 0.4) * np.exp(-L / ld)
    ax.plot(L / 1e-9, dvth * 1e3, style, lw=2,
            label=f'$V_\\mathrm{{DS}} = {vds}\\,$V')

ax.set_xlabel('Gate length $L$ (nm)')
ax.set_ylabel('$\\Delta V_\\mathrm{th}$ (mV)')
ax.legend(loc='lower right')
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
